title: Preparation of thermally curable materials using lignin extracted from sawmill co-product
content:
RSC Sustain., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4SU00767K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Libby J. Marshall, Daniel J. Cheney, Jasmine A. Keith, Christopher Kelly, Frédéric Blanc, Andrew J. West, Dave J. Adams
We describe a curable system from phenolated lignin prepared from lignin extracted from low-value biomass using ultrasonic biorefinery technology via functionalisation with benzoxazine groups.
